profile.name: Divij P
profile.title: Cloud Engineer
profile.bio: AWS Cloud Engineer at LTIMindTree with hands-on experience in cloud operations and operational readiness across enterprise AWS environments. Working with a banking client (ABSA) on cloud migration support — delivering operational readiness across patch management, AMI management, CI/CD validation, backup & restore, monitoring, alerting, and service transition. Deployed Terraform-based CloudWatch alerts via GitHub Actions pipelines, and built Python scripts and AWS Lambda automations for tag compliance, unused resource detection, and automatic alert resolution. Certified AWS Cloud Practitioner (Oct 2025). Currently advancing toward a DevOps Engineer role with a focus on automation, reliability, and Infrastructure as Code.

responsibilities: Logging, monitoring & alerting: Deployed CloudWatch alerts for servers, databases, and ECS clusters using Terraform and CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions.
Patch & AMI management: Verified SSM agent installation and configuration, AMI dates, private AMI usage, and security agent installation across environments.
CI/CD validation: Reviewed application team pipelines for compliance, including security checks such as absence of hardcoded credentials.
Backup & restore: Confirmed backup coverage for application servers; performed DR failover and snapshot-based restore activities to demonstrate recovery to application teams.
Technical change & incident management: Coordinated with application teams who handle changes and incidents through their own procedures.
Service transition: Completed operational readiness tasks and supported handover to application teams after hypercare.

Operational automation: Wrote Python scripts to extract and validate resource details across AWS accounts; built Lambda automations for notifications on unused cost-incurring resources, missing mandatory tags, and automatic CloudWatch alert resolution.

certifications.name: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner
certifications.description: Validates cloud fluency and foundational AWS knowledge.

caseStudies.title: Cloud Operational Readiness & Automation
caseStudies.subtitle: Client: ABSA (Banking) · Delivered at LTIMindTree · AWS operational readiness and automation across enterprise cloud workloads.

blocks.title: Problem
blocks.content: ABSA applications migrated to AWS required structured operational readiness validation before handover to the application teams. Each application needed to meet standards across patch management, AMI management, CI/CD, backup & restore, monitoring, alerting, and service transition — a time-intensive process that initially lacked automation.

blocks.title: Approach
blocks.content: Expanded from initial monitoring support into full operational readiness delivery. Deployed Terraform-based CloudWatch alerts via GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines for servers, databases, and ECS clusters. Wrote Python scripts to extract and validate resource configurations across multiple AWS accounts. Built Lambda automations to enforce tag compliance, surface unused cost-incurring resources, and auto-resolve stale CloudWatch alarms.

blocks.title: Tools
blocks.content: AWS (EC2, RDS, S3, Lambda, CloudWatch, SNS, SSM, ECS), Terraform (modular configurations), GitHub Actions (CI/CD pipelines), Python (cross-account resource validation scripts).

blocks.title: Outcome
blocks.content: Delivered operational readiness for multiple application sets and completed service transition to application teams after hypercare. Lambda and Python automations reduced manual validation effort, improved cost visibility, and ensured tag compliance across environments.
